name: A Promise
source:
A young man wakes up in the middle of the forest. He's disoriented and in pain, but with an enchantingly beautiful being in front of him, none of that seems to matter.

What exactly happened to you? 
Why are you bleeding so heavily?
And who is this supernatural stranger who's trying to keep you alive?

[From [url=https://saelinstudios.itch.io/a-promise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名青年在森林深处醒来。他神志不清，浑身疼痛，可面对眼前那位美得令人着迷的存在，这一切似乎都不再重要。

你究竟遭遇了什么？
为什么会流这么多血？
而这个试图让你活下去的超自然陌生人，又是谁？

（摘自[url=https://saelinstudios.itch.io/a-promise]itch.io[/url]）
